name: 最近閲覧したページのカード列
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Notion “Recently visited” cards region as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 1294x193 pixels (about 6.70:1). Preserve the broad horizontal card row and clipped right edge. Do not add the Upcoming events section or other page content.

At the upper left, show a tiny clock/history icon and the muted heading 「最近閲覧したページ」. Below it, render five full compact cards and one sixth card partly visible at the far right, matching the source's card width, rounded corners, subtle gray borders, and narrow gaps. Each card has a cover area above a white title area.

Preserve the source content and cover treatments in order: (1) a pale neutral cover with a small outline document icon and title 「クリエイティブパイプライン (2)」 on two lines; (2) a warm pale-beige cover with the waving hand emoji and title 「Notionへようこそ！」 on two lines; (3) a pale cover with an outline document icon and title 「ランディングページ」; (4) the distinctive teal-blue marbled cover with the small pair of cartoon eyes, title 「SLMobbin クリエイティブ…」 on two lines; (5) a pale cover with an outline document icon and title 「クリエイティブパイプライン」 on two lines; (6) a partly clipped, faded cover image with the title 「週次リスト」 visible in muted text on two lines. Keep the fifth card fully visible and only part of the sixth card inside the right edge.

Use small readable dark-gray sans-serif titles and a restrained Notion-like interface. Keep the heading and card row spacing, card proportions, cover heights, original visible art cues, and 1294x193 composition. Do not invent additional pages, cards, icons, or artwork; use the crop as the authority for the exact number, order, wording, clipping, and cover appearance.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the Recently visited heading, five full cards, clipped sixth card, and visible cover motifs including the hand emoji and teal marbled art with eyes. However, the 2048x768 (2.67:1) canvas is much taller than the source 1294x193 (6.70:1), and cards are proportionally larger. Similar wide items repeatedly returned constrained ratios; recorded needs-correction after one attempt.
